excludedCandidates.reason: The captured feed supplies no timestamp. Page publication evidence cannot replace an input the app did not receive. Kept as private context, excluded from replay proposals.

sampling: Twelve subject/action groups selected from captured source evidence before inspecting their deterministic family split. No matcher/embedding output was used. Fixed anchor pairs avoid adding every correlated triangle. Prior families and captured metadata are unchanged.
splitRule: SHA256(news-review-v2:family), first 8 hex digits modulo 10 >=7 is holdout; related action families kept together.
